findings.message: The cost-subtraction idea is present only as an abstract station sequence; the specific consequence of subtracting variable costs from one sale is not instantly legible.
Single sale token is visible, but the full through-line of the token moving through distinct cost stations is not clearly demonstrated.
Retained remainder is implied by the tray of blocks, but the relationship between the remainder and the original sale is not explicit enough for one-to-two-second reading.

failedRequirements: Must show: Then subtract production, payment fees, commissions, shipping, support, refunds, and every cost that increases when you sell one more unit.
successfulRequirements: No readable text, logos, readable UI, or internal labels visible
One human subject is present with clear action
regenerationInstructions: Make the sale token unmistakable as one unit entering the first station.
Increase visual separation between stations so each cost removal is obvious in sequence.
Show a visibly reduced remainder after the final station, not just a tray of extra blocks.
Reduce abstract-concept staging and make the business consequence more explicit without adding text.
